## What changes for GFW readers?

Describe the new public insight, updated dates, or corrected information. Link to relevant existing article(s).

## Sources and verification

- [ ] Each consequential new claim has been independently checked against a suitable public source.
- [ ] Source links work and quotations are brief, accurate and attributed.
- [ ] Facts, interpretations and unanswered questions are distinguished without burying the argument.
- [ ] Article `updated` date and log entry match this revision (when changing an essay).
- [ ] Event times, dates and recurrence are sourced and do not guess unknown details.
- [ ] No private civic-intelligence, supplier, personal or confidential data is included.
- [ ] New images are properly licensed, credited and accessible.

## Before merging

- [ ] Automated validation and Next.js build pass.
- [ ] Review the Vercel preview on mobile and desktop.
- [ ] Check for changed links, old deadlines and misleading page freshness labels.

Merging an approved pull request into `main` triggers Vercel production deployment after the repository is connected in Vercel Project Settings → Git. Do not merge unverified claims simply to maintain a daily posting cadence.
